description: This file defines the class ParserLabel, which is responsible for handling language labels in a module within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for saving labels, removing labels, adding labels, and handling relationship labels, primarily manipulating language PHP files and cache.

classes.name: ParserLabel
classes.description: A class to handle creation, modification, and removal of language labels for modules in SuiteCRM, including support for module builder packages and relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ParserLabel object with module and optional package names, and sets up the logger.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes incoming label parameters and saves them to the language files for a module or module package.

methods.name: removeLabel
methods.description: Removes a specified label from the language pack files of a module, with support for relationship labels.

methods.name: addLabels
methods.description: Adds or updates a set of labels in the language pack files for a specified module, supporting deployed and undeployed modules.

methods.name: handleSaveRelationshipLabels
methods.description: Handles saving of labels for relationships based on provided metadata.

methods.name: addLabelsToAllLanguages
methods.description: Adds the same labels to all supported languages for the module.
